description: This Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' implements a log filtering mechanism that strips all metadata and only outputs the message content. It acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only the log message to the next node.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that outputs only the message part of logs, omitting metadata like tags and priorities.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor accepting the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Filters the log message to pass only the message content to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
